title: ForceZero on stack init_op containing raw key bytes at all exit paths
description: Both crypto2dev_cipher() and crypto2dev_hmac() declare struct crypto2dev_init_op on the stack and fill it with the raw AES/HMAC key bytes (from Crypto2DevAesCtx or Crypto2DevHmacCtx). At every exit path (success and error), ForceZero(&init_op, sizeof(init_op)) is called to clear the key from stack memory. A contributor might remove this as 'unnecessary cleanup' since the struct is about to go out of scope. It must be preserved: the compiler is permitted to leave key material in the stack frame until the next function call overwrites it; ForceZero is the correct way to prevent key material leaking in stack traces or post-free reads.
